composition: select finite evidence lists first; emit claims, knowledge_selections, then answer_markdown; JSON key order is not a validation requirement
uniqueness: each selected fact and knowledge chunk once, even across repeated retrievals; each note once
body: one whole claim/knowledge/note reference per nonempty line; each selection exactly once
knowledge_scope: current successful MCP session and current user turn; exact returned whole chunk
rendering: host verified numeric facts and escaped exact quotations; never recursively expand retrieved templates
